description.summary: Arlen terminal grid back-pane subsurface protocol

protocol.description:
This protocol lets the Arlen terminal declare a text-grid back pane that the compositor composites under the app window. The terminal renders its cell grid (and Kitty images) into a native Wayland subsurface placed below its main webview surface; the webview is transparent where the grid shows through, and opaque where a GUI block (a "DOM hole") covers it.
The grid never travels through the webview or the app's IPC: it is a first-class compositor citizen. The app declares WHERE the grid lives and WHICH regions the DOM owns; the compositor composites and clips the back pane to match, and drives a resize handshake so the grid stays pixel-aligned through resize and reflow.
Sibling of arlen-titlebar-v1: app declares WHAT, compositor decides HOW.

interface.name: arlen_grid_manager_v1

description.summary: factory for per-window grid back-pane interfaces

interface.description: Global singleton. Clients call get_grid to obtain an arlen_grid_v1 object tied to a specific app toplevel wl_surface.

request.name: get_grid

description.summary: create a grid interface for a toplevel surface

request.description: Creates an arlen_grid_v1 object bound to the given toplevel surface (the app window). Only one grid object per surface is allowed.

interface.name: arlen_grid_v1

request.name: set_grid_surface

description.summary: designate the subsurface that carries the text grid

request.description: The given wl_surface is the back-pane grid surface (a subsurface of the toplevel). The compositor composites it under the app window and clips it to the declared region minus the DOM holes.

request.name: set_region

description.summary: the toplevel-relative rectangle the grid occupies

request.description: Logical-pixel rectangle, relative to the toplevel surface origin, that the grid back pane fills. The webview is transparent over this rectangle except where a DOM hole covers it.

request.name: set_cell_size

description.summary: logical-pixel metrics of one grid cell

request.description: Used by the compositor to pixel-align the grid to whole cells, so the back pane never smears across a sub-cell boundary on resize or scale.

request.name: set_dom_holes

description.summary: opaque DOM-block regions the grid leaves to the front pane

request.description: A JSON array of toplevel-relative logical-pixel rectangles, each an object with integer fields x, y, width and height, that the front DOM pane owns (tables, images, widgets). The compositor occludes the grid under these rectangles so the GUI block shows through. An empty array clears all holes.

request.name: ack_configure
request.description: The app acks the serial of a configure event once it has reflowed the grid to the offered size. The compositor only composites the grid at a size the app has acked, so resize stays glitch-free.

event.name: configure

description.summary: compositor offers the grid its available pixel size

event.description: Sent when the window is resized. The app reflows the grid to fit width x height (logical pixels), commits the grid surface, then calls ack_configure with this serial.
